native_mechanisms: Nightingales circle all unlocked stones and always land first on the one carrying the smallest owed letter (pick global min tentative distance by scanning the unsettled set).
Threads cast from the current tower price each road by what its thief is owed, directional (per-edge relaxation with asymmetric directed weights).

A locked letter is final and never rechalked; threads reaching bramble/tide/nowhere are dropped and those stones keep their unreadable debt (settled = final because tolls are non-negative; unreachable stay at infinity).
A knot of three threads already cast at a stone can be detached and called back on with a lower number (3-ary heap with in-place decrease-key).
core_technique: Textbook Dijkstra with two selection strategies: an O(n²) linear argmin scan over a swap-compacted unsettled array (AVX2-vectorised) for small/dense graphs, and a 3-ary heap with decrease-key for large sparse graphs, over CSR-built directed edges.
